title: A Scholarship for the Playlist
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Odile Nystrom, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
